improvements: Refreshed the complete office/Westin/podium source contours while retaining their correct shared geographic frame.
Preserved only explicitly declared building identities and changed collisions to exact source footprints.
The NE 6th St skybridge to Lincoln Square South uses the shared builder, now a glazed walkway inside an open white steel truss. Nothing else in this model changed in the pass.
remainingGaps: Hotel/office facade differences, podium levels, bridge junctions and plant setbacks remain procedural approximations.
Not every untagged roof element has an independently established metre height.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.
Truss member sizes and spacing of the skybridge are estimates from a street-level review used as viewed reference only.
